_comment: Turkish terms chosen for the chicago-school lesson. status: ok = attested in a Turkish source I opened (see content/research-notes/chicago-school.md); chosen = my own rendering of an English term (no Turkish source checked); check = weakly attested or disputed, needs a Turkish-language reviewer.

chicago-school.note: Attested in a Turkish encyclopaedia entry (KÜRE: 'Chicago Sosyoloji Ekolü' and 'Chicago Okulu' interchangeably), Turkish Wikipedia ('Chicago okulu', 'Şikago okulu', 'Ekoloji okulu', 'Ekolojik okul') and the TÜBİTAK encyclopaedia ('Chicago Okulu'). The course unit title uses 'Chicago Okulu'.

human-ecology.note: Used in the KÜRE and TÜBİTAK encyclopaedia entries on the school.

social-laboratory.note: 'sosyal laboratuvar' appears in the KÜRE entry; 'toplumsal laboratuvar' is my own variant and is only listed as an alternative in the concept text.

urbanism.note: A Turkish source (KÜRE) has a section headed 'Bir Yaşam Biçimi Olarak Kentlileşme' for Wirth's 1938 article; 'kentlileşme' can also be read as 'urbanization'. The lesson uses 'kentlilik' for 'urbanism' to keep it apart from urbanization, and says so in the exam card. Needs a reviewer.

thomas-theorem.note: No Turkish source was opened for this exact phrase; 'Thomas teoremi' is my rendering. The theorem sentence itself is translated by me.

thomas-definition-situation.note: A search-engine summary of a Turkish result rendered it 'durumun tarifi'; I could not open a Turkish source that settles the term, so 'durumun tanımı' is my choice.

immigrant-press.note: No Turkish source checked; 'yabancı dilli basın' follows the book title's 'foreign-language press' sense used in the Chicago survey.

news-as-knowledge.en: news as a form of knowledge

acquaintance-with.note: James's term; no Turkish edition of the Principles was checked.

concentric-zone-model.note: Turkish sources may say 'eşmerkezli bölgeler' or 'eş merkezli çemberler'; not checked.

communication-infrastructure.note: Ball-Rokeach et al.'s term; no Turkish usage checked.

public-opinion.note: Already used in the course's existing concept file.
